prompt:
CAMERA: 35mm cinema lens, shallow depth of field, framed from BEHIND the person at shoulder height; locked-off, then a very slow push-in over the whole shot. The camera never pulls back, never shows itself.
LOOK: match the reference frame's grade EXACTLY: dim blue-hour office, heavily desaturated near-monochrome, deep grey shadows, no daylight, no bright walls, real film grain. The ONLY colored element in the entire video is one tiny highlighter-yellow point at the raised fingertip.
STYLE: cinematic brand film, slow, held, precise. Silent except the room tone, which cuts to total silence at the freeze. No glow, no neon, no lens flare, no light particles: every dot is a matte physical grain, like a halftone made of real grains.
CHARACTER: one person, seen ONLY from behind for the whole shot, face never visible. Plain dark sweater, dark short hair, average build. Right arm raised, hand open, palm forward, held perfectly still like a conductor's hold.
SETTING: a real open-plan office at blue hour: city skyline through tall windows, rows of desks and dark monitors, sheets of paper, one colleague far in the background, a coffee cup with steam.
CONSTRAINT: no readable text anywhere, no legible numbers, no letters on any screen or paper, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no other colored element besides the single yellow point.
SCENES:
1. (~3s, medium from behind, static, same framing as the opening) The office is a frozen lattice of matte grey dots. Three thin converging pencil-like lines come back in from the upper right and thousands of small matte grains stream along them and GATHER into the shape of the person from behind, hand raised, a tiny yellow point at the fingertip. As the grains gather, the office around the person returns from dots to photographic reality.
2. (~4s, same framing) The person lowers the right arm to their side. Time RESUMES: the hanging sheets of paper fall to the floor, the far colleague finishes the step and walks on, the coffee steam rises. Room tone returns.
3. (~3s, same framing, hold) The person stands still, arm down, the yellow point still at the fingertip of the lowered hand. On the desk in the foreground a small neat stack of printed pages. Hold, calm, resolved.
